File Information
Collection: Budget Golfers API
Environment: Budget Golfers local
Collection Description
Tests for every endpoint in the COMP.7214 Assignment 2 design (Table 7), plus the error cases from Table 8 and the default 404 route. 1. Start the API (npm start) after loading the seed data (npm run seed). 2. Import this collection and the "Budget Golfers local" environment. 3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (folders in order). The seeded golfer Aroha (aroha.m@example.com / Correct-Horse-7) is used for read requests. A throwaway golfer is registered for creating, changing and deleting, and is deleted at the end, so the seed data stays the same.
